archetypes.name: producer-filename-parity
archetypes.rationale: The plan claims specific filename glob patterns for each reviewer tool; dead patterns are the exact defect class this issue repairs, so every new glob must trace to a real producer.
archetypes.prompt_body: Cross-check every filename glob pattern the plan proposes adding to design_artifact_excluded() against the actual producer scripts it names: dispatch-plan-review-panel.sh, launch-review.sh, output_for_phase in dispatch-with-waterfall.sh, and launch-claude-review.sh. Confirm that cursor-plan-*-output*.txt, codex-primary-plan-*-output*.txt, and claude-plan-*-output*.txt are the real output-path templates those scripts write, not plan-level assumptions. Verify the plan's claim that *-output*.txt (not *-output.txt) is required to cover phased fallback transcripts by tracing the phase-suffix logic in dispatch-with-waterfall.sh. Flag any pattern that has no traceable producer and any real producer output not covered by the new patterns. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: sidecar-suffix-scope
archetypes.rationale: The plan assigns distinct sidecar suffix sets to cursor vs codex vs claude producers; a wrong per-producer claim either leaks a real file into the log or adds a new dead deny pattern.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the plan's per-producer sidecar suffix lists against validate-research-output.sh (--write-structured path), launch-review.sh, collect-agent-results.sh, and launch-claude-review.sh: confirm cursor-plan-* emits .meta and .json but NOT .events.jsonl, codex-primary-plan-* does NOT emit .json (only .tsv), and claude-plan-* emits .tsv/.launch-stderr/.stderr-tail/.jsonl but not .meta or .json. Verify .cap-hit is a real cursor artifact traceable to launch-review.sh. Identify any sidecar suffix the plan denies that no producer generates, and any suffix a real producer writes that the plan omits. Also confirm the plan's assertion that .done and .events.jsonl are already covered by existing globs in design_artifact_excluded() so they need not be re-added. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: fixture-assertion-gap
archetypes.rationale: A fixture present in a test setup block but absent from its assertion loop silently loses coverage, re-introducing the same gap this plan is meant to close.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare every basename the plan adds to test-design-log-publish.sh's setup block against the deny-list assertion loop: each new fixture must appear on both sides. Verify the plan does not omit any new pattern from either side — for example, check that cursor-plan-arch-output.txt.json is both created and asserted absent. Also verify that the renamed fixtures in test-lib-design-round-artifacts.sh replace both the setup and assert sides consistently, not just the assert side. Confirm the plan correctly preserves all existing happy-path assertions (plan.txt, voter-output-1.json, plain.json, out.txt.meta) and that no new glob in the assertion loop could inadvertently match those canonical filenames. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
